# Tax filing: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Corrections to a filed return must be accepted for twelve months, under the Revenue Act 40. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a taxpayer, I want to amend my return up to a year after filing so that I can fix mistakes.
US-2 As a taxpayer, I want to see my refund status so that I know when it arrives.
US-3 As a taxpayer, I want to file my return online so that I avoid paper.
